svg.title: The exact zero pattern is load bearing. For the earlier noisy construction Eλ j = [I −(1 −λ)nj · σ]/m with 0 < λ ≤1, each effect has rank two. The same four-dimensional shift channel, which need not be the minimum realization of the noisy law, then has one-step recorded Choi rank 2m and unrecorded rank four. For n ≥2, every word is positive and the word map has pure final memory but an input effect proportional to Eλ w1 ⊗Eλ w2, of rank four. Consequently its complete-channel Choi rank is 4mn, although its stationary fixed-output state without an initial retained reference has rank only mn. This is a concrete reason not to replace a retained-reference channel task by one fixed-input density matrix when counting environment. These ranks are exact channel identities, not robust physical costs at finite tolerance. At λ = 1 the output law is IID uniform and a one-dimensional source suffices; the four-dimensional shift’s dilation ranks are plainly not process-wide minima. The exact and finite-accuracy realization results elsewhere in this companion must be used for the corresponding task and tolerance. No discontinuous exact rank jump is offered as an experimentally discontinuous hardware demand.
